kimi.zh: 新套餐：Go、Plus、Pro、Max、Ultra。Plus 起提供 Kimi Code，Pro 起提供高速版和 1M 上下文。新套餐使用 5 小时窗口及月总额度；老套餐保留周窗口。
kimi.en: Current tiers: Go, Plus, Pro, Max and Ultra. Kimi Code starts at Plus; Pro adds Highspeed and 1M context. New plans use a 5-hour window and monthly total; legacy plans retain weekly limits.

minimax.zh: M Plan：Go、Explore、Build，均包含 M3.1 Flash；Explore、Build 另含 H3 视频。原 Token Plan 的 Plus、Max、Ultra 保留。使用现有 MiniMax 查询凭据。
minimax.en: M Plan: Go, Explore and Build, all including M3.1 Flash. Explore and Build also include H3 video. Legacy Token Plan Plus, Max and Ultra remain. Uses the existing MiniMax quota credential.

go.zh: Go 为 $10/月，Go Plus 为 $40/月。新增 Kimi K3.1 Pro、MiniMax M3.1 Flash 等模型，各模型使用独立的月度额度标准。
go.en: Go costs $10/month; Go Plus costs $40/month. Includes Kimi K3.1 Pro, MiniMax M3.1 Flash and other additions, with model-specific monthly allowances.

tencent-token.zh: 腾讯通用 Token Plan 与 Hy Token Plan 共用 API Key 和请求地址，按模型从对应套餐扣减积分。当前支持套餐归属统计。
tencent-token.en: Tencent Token Plan and Hy Token Plan share an API key and endpoints; credits are deducted from the applicable plan for each model. Plan classification is supported.
